row.notes: pod_2019_1st_script::initialise (vtable slot 0x1455f6ee0, ~2900 lines): sets cutscene params (HQ characters, skip frustum culling, prewarm textures, start-time offset), binds the parcferme_geo / podium2022_parcferme_geo world, lead engineer asset group, and builds all podium sequences: runon (runonEdriver_placed_first/second/third, runonEENG, camera, background, podium_screen), tunnel walk (podium2022_tunnelWalk), trophy crowd flyovers (podium2022_celebrate_trophy_crowd_01/02_flyover, podium2022_podium_flyover_cars), crowd wide (podium_podium_crowd_wide), champagne bottles, TV screens, podium_audio, pod_emote, spawns drivers with race result (male/_reverse variants). Addon: list of animation/scene names to swap for custom podium cutscenes. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner re-career-teams (independent agree V2532)  | 2026-11-17 engine-re round A2: track-name scene: builds 'crowd_wide_cam_' + this+0x930 (the digit-cut track name, lower-cased) and, when longer than 10 chars and ending in '_reverse' (0x145624725, strcmp at 0x14036847c), cuts the suffix; then Game_CameraActorEnable_SpawnScene. So reverse layouts reuse the forward track's podium crowd camera scene and a new code needs a scene named crowd_wide_cam_<code> (missing-scene behaviour: T203). raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested)
